headline: Franklin Pierce shut out Bentley in members' first meeting
dek: Franklin Pierce kept Bentley scoreless in the first match between two NE10 sides this season, and their eleven goals now trail only Southern New Hampshire's fourteen. Bentley have conceded nine in four matches and have lost the last two of them.

pattern.label: signal
pattern.text: The two tallest bars are built differently: nine players have scored Southern New Hampshire's fourteen goals, while Franklin Pierce's eleven come from four.

wire.line: Franklin Pierce kept a clean sheet against Bentley in the season's first match between conference members.
